sections.description:
Royal Carrybee is a 100% FREE & Open-Source WooCommerce shipping and courier automation plugin for Carrybee courier service in Bangladesh.

Features include instant 1-click parcel dispatch from Orders list, intelligent City & Zone auto-matching, real-time webhook parcel tracking, cascading checkout dropdowns, and nationwide coverage across 64 districts in Bangladesh.
sections.installation:
1. Upload royal-carrybee.zip through WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin or install via Git.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Configure your Carrybee API credentials under WooCommerce > Carrybee.
  4. Add Carrybee to your WooCommerce Shipping Zones under WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping.
